title: EvaluationRun v1
description: One evaluation run (ARCHITECTURE 3.8; ADR-0006 decisions 1-8): the hash-pinned case and suite, the candidate artifact binding, the frozen run envelope, runner and environment, the frozen output artifact, the scorer with its level, the multi-dimensional score vector (never a single cross-domain total), the six hard-gate outcomes, the verdict, and the L0/L1 coverage declaration.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact case record version.

case.description: The evaluation case this run executes. One-directional and hash-pinned.

sha256.description: Mandatory content hash pinning the exact suite snapshot.

suite.description: The suite snapshot this run belongs to. One-directional and hash-pinned.

sha256.description: Hash of the immutable candidate artifact (ADR-0006 decision 3: candidates are hash-bound artifact descriptors, not core records, in this phase).

candidate.description: The candidate artifact under evaluation, bound by content hash.

envelope_sha256.description: Hash of the full frozen envelope artifact (timeout, output cap, retry policy, seed, config). The hash is authoritative; the echoed fields below are informational.

timeout_ms.description: Optional echo of the frozen timeout.

max_output_bytes.description: Optional echo of the frozen output size cap.

retry_attempts.description: Optional echo of the frozen retry budget.

seed.description: Optional echo of the injected seed.

envelope.description: The frozen run envelope (ADR-0006 decisions 3-4), bound by content hash.

model.description: Optional model identifier when a model drove the candidate.

environment.description: Runtime environment notes (OS, interpreter, hardware class). Free-form in v1.

output_sha256.description: Hash of the frozen output artifact that was replayed and scored.

locator.description: Optional safe relative path to the frozen output artifact.

output.description: The frozen output artifact under replay scoring (L1), bound by content hash.

calibration_sha256.description: Optional hash of the calibration evidence artifact; meaningful only for calibrated_judge.

score_vector.description: Per-dimension scores (ADR-0006 decision 6). There is deliberately no aggregate or total field: no cross-domain single score exists.

gate.description: One of the six hard gates (ADR-0006 decision 8).

reason.description: Structured reason, required by discipline whenever result is fail.

gate_results.description: Per-gate outcomes. Any fail fails the run as a whole.

verdict.description: Run verdict. error means the runner/scorer pipeline itself failed; inconclusive is a legitimate terminal and is never forced into pass/fail.

error_class.description: Structured error classification (ADR-0006 decision 4). Meaningful only when verdict is error.

levels_covered.description: Evaluation levels this run actually covers (ARCHITECTURE 6; ADR-0006 decision 2). L0/L1 results must never be phrased as L2/L3/L4 coverage.
